items.title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services
items.summary: OpenAI is taking aim at some of Wall Street's most labor-intensive tasks with a new version of ChatGPT designed to research companies, analyze financial data and generate the presentations that investment bankers rely on.

items.title: Kalshi launches ‘perps’ for gold and silver following CFTC approval, expanding futures offerings
items.summary: Kalshi has won approval to list perpetual futures tied to precious metals gold and silver in the U.S., in the latest development as the company seeks to grow its trading offerings beyond prediction markets .

items.title: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
items.summary: Fintech company Ant International announced Thursday it has signed on Visa and Mastercard to collaborate on a new standard for payments made via AI agents, in a bet that they will be used more and more by consumers and businesses.

items.title: Friday's CPI inflation report is even more important than usual. Here's what to expect
items.summary: A report due out Friday morning will be the last piece of the inflation puzzle the Federal Reserve will get before making its decision on interest rates next week.

items.title: The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher
items.summary: A swell of unfriendly factors for inflation likely will push the Federal Reserve to an interest rate hike next week and there's possibly another before the end of the year, judging by market pricing Thursday.

items.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected
items.summary: U.S. wholesale prices rose in August, according to a report Thursday that could play a key role in the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision.
